arguments.purpose: Public comparison chronological overview and edit continuity check
Revisit wide room shot to verify sofa opposite fireplace and window end
Verify kitchen is contiguous with fireplace living space across a wide shot, rather than infer adjacency from an edit

arguments.text: Wide shots show a sofa against large rattan-framed mirrors opposite a fireplace/TV, tall windows at one end, and a gold-cabinet kitchenette with dining banquette adjoining the fireplace end. Bathroom shots show a tub; its connection to the main space is not demonstrated by the viewed wide shots.
arguments.limitation: Edited 182.72-second tour; overview approximately every five seconds, with two one-second-detail windows. No audio verification or complete floor-plan recovery.

arguments.text: Bathroom access, sleeping arrangement, entry location and exact footprint cannot be established from the inspected evidence. The on-screen 296-square-foot label is a publisher claim, not a measurement recovered from pixels.
arguments.limitation: Do not join separate edited detail shots as a continuous route.

arguments.purpose: Test best-fit sleeping and storage arrangement rather than leave edited studio unconnected

arguments.text: Targeted rewatch shows a folding Murphy bed on the fireplace-side wall near the window end. The central panel between windows is a mirror, not a bathroom doorway. Bathroom access remains unobserved.
arguments.limitation: Unmeasured geometry; edited sequences do not prove continuous adjacency.
